title: Dukkha (2)
text: 1-3 Sāvatthi || || Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Rādho Bhagavantam etad avoca || || Dukkhadhammo dukkhadhammoti bhante vuccati || || Katamo nu kho bhante dukkhadhammoti || || 4 Rūpaṃ kho bhante dukkhadhammo || vedanā dukkhadhammo saññā || saṅkhārā dukkhadhammo || viññāṇaṃ dukkhadhammo || || 5 Evam passaṃ || pe || nāparam itthattāyāti pajānātīti || ||
